ctr.description: The read counter, in hex, from a plain-mirror tag.

uid.description: The tag's serial number, in hex.

picc.description: The encrypted serial number and counter, in hex, from an encrypted-mirror tag. Supply exactly one of ctr and picc.

errors.name: CreatorUnavailable
errors.description: The creator's deck can't be reached. Retry the same tap; if that returns replayed, tap again.

proof.description: Write it whenever it's present, even when valid is false. When valid, it's the scan just made; when reason is alreadyCollected, it's the scanner's earlier scan of this card, signed again.

main.description: Checks a tap of a Sunshine Card. Called through the scanner's PDS (service auth), it also returns a signed scan record for the caller to write into the scanner's repo.

did.description: The scanner: the repo to write to.

proof.description: A signed scan record, with the arguments com.atproto.repo.createRecord needs to write it.
